name: Assault on Fenris Isle
summary: High Executor Hadrec sends Forsaken agents to Fenris Isle. They are to storm Fenris Keep and take the head of Thule Ravenclaw, the necromancer commanding the island stronghold in Lake Lordamere.

sections.title: Purging Lake Lordamere
sections.body: The Forsaken hold the western roads and have made their presence known at the Sepulcher. Yet the Scourge remain entrenched in Fenris Keep, on an island in Lake Lordamere east of Silverpine Forest. Their forces threaten the forest and the southern waterways that lead toward the Undercity. High Executor Hadrec sees Thule Ravenclaw’s experiments as a danger to Forsaken control of Silverpine. From the keep, Thule commands the Scourge close to the Forsaken shore.

sections.title: The Fall of Thule Ravenclaw
sections.body: Rot hide gnolls and shambling undead guard the way through Fenris Keep to Thule Ravenclaw. The necromancer curses his attackers and leeches their vitality, strengthening his own strikes. When he falls, his severed head proves his death. Magical shockwaves reach the Sepulcher, where Apothecary Renferrel detects them.

faq.q: Why does High Executor Hadrec want Thule Ravenclaw dead?
faq.answer: Thule Ravenclaw leads the Scourge on Fenris Isle. His forces threaten the Forsaken stronghold at the Sepulcher and the waterways across Lake Lordamere. Hadrec demands Thule’s head as proof that the Scourge’s regional command is broken.

Thule Ravenclaw resides deep inside the ruined castle on Fenris Isle, in the middle of Lake Lordamere east of Silverpine Forest. He holds court in the keep’s lower communal hall, guarded by undead retainers and twisted minions.

faq.q: What happens when Thule Ravenclaw dies?
faq.answer: Thule’s death sends a great wave of dark necromantic energy across the region. At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel detects the unraveling magic, and High Executor Hadrec commends the strike as a strategic triumph for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Who controls Fenris Isle before this assault?
faq.answer: The Scourge occupy Fenris Isle. Thule Ravenclaw uses its castle as a staging ground, commanding reanimated undead and blight-twisted rot hide gnolls to terrorize Lake Lordamere’s waters.

faq.q: Why was Bethor's Potion important for this mission?
faq.answer: Thule casts Hex of the Ravenclaw, a curse that weakens his opponents and magnifies his own power. Bethor Iceshard supplied counter-incantations, which Apothecary Renferrel brewed into a potion during earlier operations to neutralize the necrotic curse.

faq.q: What is the strategic significance of Fenris Isle to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: Fenris Isle sits in Lake Lordamere, bordering Silverpine and the Hillsbrad foothills. Securing or neutralizing the island removes an enemy outpost that can attack Silverpine and clears a major Scourge presence from Lordaeron’s borders.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you have personal reason to seek retribution against Thule Ravenclaw. Crushing Scourge outposts proves your people have broken free of the Lich King’s will.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on the Forsaken to steady Silverpine and Tirisfal against rival powers and the wandering Scourge.
As a mage, you may share Bethor Iceshard and Apothecary Renferrel’s interest in the magical fallout of Thule’s death and the violent dispersal of his necrotic weaves.
